roles.name: Agent_1
roles.title: experiment lead
duties: Decide the procedure and the order of measurements.
State the setup precisely enough for another team to repeat it.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

roles.name: Agent_2
roles.title: data recorder
duties: Record every measurement with units and stated uncertainty.
Never adjust a recorded value to fit an expectation.

roles.name: Agent_3
roles.title: analysis / calculations
duties: Turn recorded data into the required quantities, showing the work.
Carry uncertainty through the calculation instead of dropping it.
